items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: uptime-kuma
items.summary: Uptime Kuma 是一款自托管的监控工具，让开发者能够独立追踪网站和服务可用性，摆脱对第三方监控服务的依赖。它采用 WebSocket 实现实时状态更新，当服务异常时通过多种渠道即时发送警报。你可以用 Docker 快速部署，自定义监控频率，并将其集成到现有架构中，为个人项目或小团队提供可靠的运维保障，非常适合需要自主控制监控流程的场景。
items.summary_en: Uptime Kuma is a self-hosted monitoring tool that helps developers track website and service availability without relying on third-party services. It uses WebSocket connections for real-time status updates and provides instant notifications via multiple channels when services go down. You can deploy it easily using Docker, customize monitoring intervals, and integrate it with your existing infrastructure to maintain reliable service oversight for personal projects or small teams.

items.name: opencode
items.summary: OpenCode是一个开源编码代理，能够理解自然语言指令并自动生成可运行代码，帮助开发者自动化编程任务。它基于大型语言模型技术，通过解析开发者的需求描述来生成多种编程语言的实现代码。该项目采用TypeScript开发，提供了清晰的API接口，开发者可以将其集成到自己的开发流程中，用于快速原型构建、自动化代码生成或辅助编程工作，特别适合需要频繁处理重复编码模式的场景。
items.summary_en: OpenCode is an open-source coding agent that automates software development tasks by understanding natural language instructions and generating functional code. It leverages large language models to interpret developer intent and produce working implementations across multiple programming languages. Developers can integrate it into their workflows through its TypeScript API to automate repetitive coding tasks, prototype ideas quickly, or assist with code generation in integrated development environments.

items.name: metube
items.summary: MeTube是一款自托管的网络应用，它解决了用户依赖外部服务下载YouTube视频的问题，让用户能够完全掌控自己的媒体收藏。该项目通过简洁的网页界面封装了yt-dlp等强大命令行工具，将复杂的下载操作转化为直观的点击操作，降低了技术门槛。部署时只需使用Docker在个人服务器上运行，即可用来下载多种格式的视频、创建播放列表，或存档教育内容供离线学习使用，特别适合需要批量管理视频资源的场景。
items.summary_en: MeTube is a self-hosted web application that solves the problem of downloading YouTube videos without relying on external services, giving users full control over their media collection. It works by providing a clean web interface that wraps powerful command-line tools like yt-dlp, making complex downloading operations accessible through simple clicks. You can deploy it on your own server using Docker, then use it to download videos in various formats, create playlists, or archive educational content for offline access and personal use.

items.name: Handy
items.summary: Handy是一款开源离线语音转文字应用，通过本地化处理解决隐私和网络依赖问题，让转录更安全可靠。它基于TypeScript和Tauri v2框架实现跨平台运行，核心设计在于利用轻量级本地引擎替代云端服务，兼顾效率与可扩展性。用户可将其用于实时字幕生成、会议记录或辅助工具，开发者也能通过插件机制定制功能，适合需要离线、可定制转录场景的实践探索。
items.summary_en: Handy is an open-source speech-to-text application that enables reliable offline transcription, addressing privacy concerns and connectivity limitations. Built with TypeScript and Tauri v2, it leverages efficient local processing to deliver cross-platform accessibility without cloud dependencies. Developers can extend its functionality through plugins, while users benefit from customizable workflows for real-time captioning, note-taking, or accessibility tools in diverse environments.

items.name: JoltPhysics
items.summary: JoltPhysics是一个专为现代游戏和VR应用设计的高性能刚体物理与碰撞检测库。它通过多核友好的架构创新，将物理计算任务高效分配到多个CPU核心上，解决了传统物理引擎在复杂场景下的性能瓶颈问题。开发者可以将其集成到C++游戏引擎中，用于实现逼真的物体交互、车辆物理或环境破坏系统，其技术已被《地平线：西之绝境》等AAA游戏验证，为独立开发者到大型工作室提供了可靠的物理模拟解决方案。
items.summary_en: JoltPhysics is a high-performance rigid body physics and collision detection library designed for modern game development and VR applications. Its key innovation is a multi-core friendly architecture that efficiently distributes physics calculations across CPU cores, enabling complex simulations without performance bottlenecks. Developers can integrate it into C++ game engines to create realistic object interactions, vehicle physics, or environmental destruction systems, with Horizon Forbidden West demonstrating its production-ready capabilities in AAA gaming.

items.name: pg-aiguide
items.summary: pg-aiguide 是一个 MCP 服务器和 Claude 插件，旨在通过为 AI 编码助手提供结构化数据库知识来生成更准确的 PostgreSQL 查询。它通过模型上下文协议暴露 PostgreSQL 的模式信息、文档和查询模式，使 AI 工具能够访问实时数据库上下文。开发者可将其与 Claude Code 或其他兼容 MCP 的工具集成，从而获得尊重其特定数据库结构的 AI 生成 SQL，适用于快速原型设计查询或通过交互式编码学习 PostgreSQL 最佳实践，提升开发效率与代码质量。
items.summary_en: pg-aiguide is an MCP server and Claude plugin that helps AI coding assistants generate more accurate PostgreSQL queries by providing them with structured database knowledge. It works by exposing PostgreSQL schema information, documentation, and query patterns through the Model Context Protocol, allowing AI tools to access real-time database context. Developers can integrate it with Claude Code or other MCP-compatible tools to get AI-generated SQL that respects their specific database structure, making it practical for prototyping queries or learning PostgreSQL best practices through interactive coding.

items.name: electra-base-discriminator
items.summary: ELECTRA-base-discriminator是一种基于判别式预训练的Transformer模型，通过将掩码语言建模改为区分真实与生成器产生的替代标记，显著提升训练效率。其核心创新是使用小型生成器产生替代标记，再由判别器识别真假，比BERT等模型训练更快且性能强劲。开发者可通过Hugging Face库微调该模型，应用于文本分类、命名实体识别或问答任务，特别适合计算资源有限但需要高质量语言理解的场景。

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: fairface_age_image_detection
items.summary: FairFace 年龄图像检测模型基于 Vision Transformer 架构，能够从人脸图像中精准估算年龄，解决了人工标注效率低下的问题。该模型在涵盖多种族、多光照条件的 FairFace 数据集上微调，显著提升了跨人群的年龄识别鲁棒性。开发者可通过 Hugging Face 接口快速部署，适用于适龄内容过滤、零售客群分析或社会科学研究等场景，也可根据特定需求微调模型，以在实际应用中获得更准确的年龄预测结果。
